facts.value: MyPath2ASU® is not required to transfer to ASU, but it can make the transfer journey simpler and cost-effective by aligning coursework with the intended ASU major.
Complete your steps to apply six months to a year before your intended start term at ASU.
Maximize your transfer credits and complete your degree faster, saving you time and money.

Jacob Stillwell transferred from Mesa Community College to ASU through MyPath2ASU®. The program helped Jacob stay on track, ensuring a smooth transition to the university. Now he’s ready to make an impact in government or environmental consulting.
